title: Great figures he met said we are not alone

tellings.quote: You know these kinds of minds, the greatest minds, real geniuses, all of them said we are not alone.

plain: The president of a Russian republic, speaking to Jesse Michels in 2025, says that the greatest minds he met, "real geniuses", all told him that we are not alone in the universe. He names Pope John Paul II, the Dalai Lama, the Bulgarian seer Baba Vanga, the Indian guru Sai Baba, the American statesman Henry Kissinger and the Russian physicist Zhores Alferov. If he is right, some of the best-known figures of the last century privately believed in life beyond Earth.
